name: The King & I: Coming Out of Your Shell
source:
Oh, no! You've been kidnapped by Bowser! What now? Well... you two have some time to kill. Alone. In his bedroom.

This is a short interactive fiction, featuring you and the Hothead Hunk of the Koopa Kingdom. Two routes: "Top" and "Bottom."

[From [url=http://lovegames.itch.io/the-king-and-i-ep1]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
哦，不！你被库巴绑架了！现在怎么办？嗯…你们两个还有时间消磨时间。独自的。在他的卧室里。

这是一部简短的互动小说，主角是你和库帕王国的急躁大块头。两条路线：“顶部”和“底部”。

[来自[url=http://lovegames.itch.io/the-king-and-i-ep1]itch.io[/url]]
